text_block_list.text:
One day, I bumped into Air Shakur in town.
As we walked along the same road back to the academy...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

Air Shakur doesn't seem interested...
but we received a raffle ticket when we went shopping earlier.
choice_data_list: Want to give it a spin?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Why? Go do whatever you want on your own.
choice_data_list: If it's Air Shakur, she could probably hit whatever she aims at.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Come on, man...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A lottery ain't something you try to rig.
You're supposed to enjoy the thrill of seeing what you get, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Where's your sense of romance, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No way in hell.

Air Shakur doesn't seem interested in the raffle.
However, if I could win the grand prize—the hot springs trip—then maybe...
choice_data_list: (This might be a nice break for Shakaar)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Um...
Are you gonna do it? Or not?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oh.
Naturally, the target is...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
How many tens of thousands of times do you plan on trying?
I'm telling you, there's no way you're winning.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Come on, spin it.

Under Air Shakur's vaguely curious gaze...
I turn the crank on the lottery wheel!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ooh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This has turned into...
a very interesting result.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey. How many people in total have drawn this lottery up till today?
What percentage of the whole is the grand prize?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is customer distribution, crowd rotation...
Got any summary of the trends so far?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Umm...
I don't really get that kinda stuff.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well, guess that's true.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, young lady, it's the grand prize, but...
aren't you happy? It's a hot spring trip, you know. A hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That punk's the one who wants to go.
I don't give a damn.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer!
Have a great time!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You were aiming for the hot springs trip, weren't ya?
Show a little more excitement.
choice_data_list: Doesn't Air Shakur like hot springs?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I don't really care about hot springs themselves.
But when it comes to a hot springs trip, I hate it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Being around people all the time is unbearable in the first place.
Besides, what's the point of taking a bath with others anyway?
choice_data_list: How do you usually take a bath?
How do you usually take a bath?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I just pick a time when nobody's around
to take a quick shower.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll take a bath if I gotta.
But if I don't have to, I ain't gonna.

It seems Air Shakur doesn't like bathing
in the first place. An onsen probably
wouldn't make him very happy.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I mean, why ask a question like that? You've always drawn the line in your own way, haven't you?
choice_data_list: I was just curious, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...If that's really the case,
what you're focusing on is way too gross.
And so, the destination for the hot springs trip ticket we had brilliantly won remained temporarily unknown...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
First prize, huh.
Too bad you missed what you were aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well, in terms of results. The real question is whether that's what you actually wanted.
choice_data_list: I'll give this to Air Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Don't need it, though.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Huh, usually Umamusume come here
after the carrot hamburger steak, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...
I'm not interested."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"It's sooooo delicious, though.
The butcher, baker, greengrocer, restaurants...
Our best gave it their all and took real pride in making it!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hear that?
Good for you.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Huh.
Even this doesn't tempt you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If it has the nutrients I need,
I'll eat it without being told.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
No way! I have my pride too, you know.
I'm making these prizes so the Umamusume
will genuinely love them.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
I ain't letting you go
until I see a smile on your face, little lady...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mom! You there!?
Heat up some hamburger steaks for me right now!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah? 
Hey, I don't need this.

Air Shakur ended up tasting the special carrot
hamburg steak right then and there.
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Tasty.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
Told you it's delicious, didn't I!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I don't know much about taste and all that,
but it ain't bad.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Alright, then just smile like this—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I won't.
Despite his grumbling, Air Shakur cleaned his plate completely.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Orange.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Packed with nutrients!
Eat up and enjoy."
choice_data_list: (Maybe I should hand these out to the students at the academy.)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
By the way, we can deliver it, but...
you've got an Umamusume with you, so wanna just carry it back real quick?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: No, I'll take it home myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"It's preeeetty heavy.
Are you sure you're okay?"

When designing Air Shakur's training,
there are times I work out myself to understand it physically.
I was fairly confident in my strength compared to others my age.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...At least borrow a cart.

On the way back carrying a massive load of carrots.
Just as Air Shakur advised, I managed to borrow a cart from the shopping district, but—

Perhaps because my pace had slowed to a crawl,
Air Shakur ended up heading home ahead of me...
choice_data_list: (I said it myself, so I have to do my best!)

text_block_list.text: Just as we were making progress, step by step—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Are you the
"Carrot Handout Trainer"?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I saw it going viral on Umatter!
Apparently, a Trainer is currently heading toward the academy
to hand out massive amounts of carrots.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She said if we go pick them up early,
we'll get extra carrots...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'll take some.
...As much as possible!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Carrots for us too,
pleeease!

And just like that, the Umamusume gathered around,
and in the blink of an eye,
the carrots dwindled away...

By the time we got back to the academy, everything had been handed out.
Since we had planned to give them to the students anyway,
not having to carry them back was a huge relief.
choice_data_list: (So the one who spread the word was...)

text_block_list.text: "...'I'll tell them how grateful I am when I see them tomorrow.' That was what I was thinking, but—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's the carrot-distributing Trainer!
Hello~.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.
For a while after that, she was troubled by the mysterious nickname.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Too bad.
They say there's only one.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Here it is.
Hurry up and take it."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Kinda hilarious, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The portrait of a human holding a single carrot,
lost and bewildered...

"...This might just be my chance to entertain Air Shakur!
Thinking this, I hoisted a carrot like a sword—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Nah, I'm good without that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Doing it on purpose is a total buzzkill.
The last one was funny 'cause you didn't mean to.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Also, I can't stand people who suck up to me.
Don't get cocky.

...The carrots I ate after getting home
had such a gentle sweetness to them...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Looks like you lost.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Probabilistically, this is 'bout what you'd expect.
choice_data_list: I wanted to take Air Shakur to the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...So that's what this is about, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I even wanted to go in the first place.
Yet you're getting all depressed on your own. Annoying.

Even as she said that, it felt as though she was a little disappointed...
Or maybe... I was just imagining it.
